svg.text: Near-silent bed, wet organic foley, music only at level-up and round end. The dish sounds like a real slide under a lamp.
Evolution · audio direction · build 1 (hooks now, assets later)
First ten minutes of a round (fast solo player, GAME-DESIGN §5.1 pace curve)
flat room tone; stings (2 s) at each level-up, 20 s piece at round end
soft wet "plip"; 6 round-robin variants, pitch drops as your mass grows; -6 dB after 3 in a row
glassy tick + a short breathy whisper; lifts slightly with the tag colour
the only music: a 2 s piano-and-glass sting (one per ladder stage); pick = soft click
slow wet slurp swell that follows engulf progress; ends in a thick gulp
a single low sub-thud when a threat ring appears; no loop
muffled internal thump, then everything low-passes to silence for the 3 s spectate
a faint bubble rising and popping
no cue: the layer changes are the tell (see zones)
a 20 s resolving piece under the results screen; only real music of the round
bed -34 LUFS (barely audible); cues peak -14 dBFS; eat cooldown 120 ms
≈ 12–18 sounds per minute in Graze, ≈ 20 in Bloom; silence is the default state
music: ≈ 10 stings + 1 piece per round; ≈ 40 s of music in 10 minutes
condenser-lamp hum + faint liquid room tone (loop 60 s)
+ high airy shimmer, almost inaudible (loop 45 s)
+ slow bubble ticks, one every 2–4 s (loop 40 s)
no new layer: low-pass 2 kHz on everything
Music reacts to the ladder: no
(the level-up sting has one variant per stage; the bed never changes)
